Name: Sword of Ruin
Effect: Reduce by 2 the Defense of everyone in the field, except this Pokémon. This Pokémon is immune to the effects of the Abilities: Beads of Ruin, Sword of Ruin, Tablets of Ruin, and Vessel of Ruin. Unique Ability.
Description: There is a cursed artifact on this Pokémon. A cold hatred takes harbor inside everyone's hearts. This Pokémon loves to instigate conflict amongst others.
